description: EPL insert-into empty-property-type and event-typed-column parity replaying four executions across six cases: named-window-model-after replays EPLInsertIntoNamedWindowModelAfter, an empty-schema keepall window populated by a zero-column insert-into, a fire-and-forget insert/delete pair, an on-SupportBean_S0 not-matched merge insert and an on-SupportBean_S1 insert, observed through window snapshots and a value record pinning the row event-type name; create-schema-map, create-schema-objectarray and create-schema-bean are the map, objectarray and bean sub-rounds of EPLInsertIntoCreateSchemaInsertInto (the map sub-round's soda=true/false double run is compile-path-only and replayed once), each sending one SupportBean into an empty schema and observing the s0 listener row, the objectarray case's subscriber delivery, and a value record pinning the delivered row's event-type name; event-typed-column-on-merge and pojo-typed-column-on-merge replay EPLInsertIntoEventTypedColumnOnMerge and EPLInsertIntoPOJOTypedColumnOnMerge, where an on-merge writes the triggering event into a table's event-typed lastevent column and into CarOutputStream's outputevent column, and a one-minute timeout pattern deletes the table row and emits the stored event offline, observed through s0 listener records
